book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Iesu la ugama irie kuguom a wain migat
Tie, Iesu la tiesong gare ro, “Turuo kan kuguom a wain migat. Pa Mamo ruang la irie Mamo iang uriro ubi a wain.

Mirier muareip ira ruo la tale mime lopmaiat, Mamo la ume mavugutuara. Mirier muareip la mime lopmaiat, ume maraga babap ma mila kiram ga makosarong muareip meba babaim ba, meba lopmaiaring muareip maset.
Mibabaim ara. Memani, o uriro ties la tualo miun, uriro la mikosarieng ga mibabaim.

Parepming ira ruo, ga eba pareptang ira mi. Leba tale parepieng muaranim o kuguom a wain iro kuguom, tie tala kan iario parak urie kan. Aret tie ga leba tale pareming ira ruo, tala kan puoming meba miaring parak.
Turuo kan kuguom a wain, pa mimi gare muareip tuo. Parepming ira ruo ga eba pareptang ira mi, ga eba miaring papot parak. Pa leba tomiolaing, tale kan puoming meba akosarming paga ba.
Migana la tale parepong ira ruo, tie eba akomeng gare muaranim o kuguom, ga eba laluo ba. Ga mime mepamuam miriro muareip ga mime mago na kit ga suammeng.
Leba parepming ira ruo ga ties tung gat la iot na dalap mi, tie eba marikming a man paga la naming aime, ga eba alang Morowa irie paga miun.
Mumuru le miaring papot parak meba mionang mimi lop tuam o usingnualap. Met iriro tavuk Mamo ruang leba arang bonim ula kakanu.
Mamo la mitara naong me rulam ga nat iriro tavuk la narung me milam. Tie man mionang it busit tapma na ubonuvarap tung.
Leba omiuluo maset maimai rung, tie eba mionang una ubonuvarap tung. Are tie la oruluan maset maimai ang Mamo ruang, ga tunama una ubonuvarap ang.
Narung me tenubap tung le iot miun ga uriro tenubap la dakieng na dalap mi. Are ratmat ga tuaramo uriro ties mi.
“Tie, maimai rung la are ro: Mimi ut narit narit le naming maset me non ara, are turuo la narung me milam.
Karuk kan o ubonuvarap ba ang noba la kakanu me ira noba la ualo ninimiap ang me migap am.
Mimi migap tuam, leba makosarming mirier pagap la mirulo ma. Tie eba mimi ba papap tuam.

Migana o ubi la tale mait pagap migana ang ila kakani la ume makosar. Are ratmat ga tale gat miriva teip o ubi. Karuk. Mirier tiesiap la tume tuptam aun Mamo ruang la tume mirulo ma. Are ratmat ga miriva papap tuam.

Tale kan toiteming meba tonang ga mimi. Karuk. Turuo kan la miterung meba mimi ba gar tuang. Ga miterung me ubi, meba mila ga miaring parak, meba iot maset. Are ratmat ga na bonim tuo leba marikming me ai Mamo meba alang noba paga miun, tie eba alang.
Are ratmat ga tualo maimai miun gare ro, “Mimi ut narit narit le naming migat me non ara.
Inamaniap onim na kimanam leba nekaromela ga lop o usingnualap
“Tie, teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam leba nekaromela ga mimi, agatming it na dalap mi gare ro: Lake nekaromela ga turuo.

Leba mionang gare teip ga magaulap onim na uro kimanam, tie teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam la eba nameng me milam gare gar kan maiang. Pa tale mimi teip gare mirie. Karuk. Miterung ara meba amiolaing tavuk onim na urogo kimanam. Are ratmat ga teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam leba nekaromela ga mimi.

Oagatming maset uriro ties la tuaramo mi. Migana o ubi la tale kan akurupin migana ang Ila Kakani. Lake tokirarameng. Are ratmat ga eba gat mikirarameng. Leba meptang ties tung ga omeuluan. Tie, eba gat meptang ties ming ga omeuluo.
Memani, tale kan ameit Mamo, irie la tosagaong ga muruo na uro kimanam. Pa mimi la gar tuang. Are ratmat ga eba makosarmeng miriro tavukup mila kiram ganam ira mi.
La tale muruo na uriro kimanam ga talang ties ang Mamo maun, tie eba tale memaning kirinim. Pa titot la tale memaning alang meba mereing kirinim maiong.
Man migana la nekaroula ga turuo, eba gat nekaroala ga Mamo ruang.

La tale tunama kabirana ma ga makosartang miriro ubiap mila kakanim la karuk a noba migana la makosarong tinan, tie eba tale memaning kirinim. Pa magimameng ara miriro ubiap tuam ga nekaromelat agarit ga turuo ga Mamo ruang gat.
Iriro tavuk la akosarmeng la betong meba ovuomeng non ties la iot na babam o maimai maiong. Uriro ties la igama: ‘Nekaromelat agarit ga turuo.’
Pa Muranama meba mingangasang la unama ga Mamo ga eba asagarang ga muong mi. Irie Muranama o ties migat, la eba muong ai Mamo. Eva, na tara leba muong eba, bais ang la uakap o ties tung ga ubi rung.
Ga mimi gat le baisming o ties tung. Memani, mimi gat la mionama ga turuo na tara la puruaro ubi, ga muio puoieng titot.
